name: ai-pass
description: Integrate AI Pass user-funded wallets or app-funded per-user AI allowances in web, mobile, server and agent-built applications.

interface.longDescription: Integrate AI Pass where an application already lives. Users can connect their own wallet, or the app can fund per-user allowances through a server-held owner key and restricted execution OAuth.
capabilities: Integrate user-funded AI in web, mobile, desktop, server, and ChatGPT apps
Provision public OAuth clients through browser-approved device authorization
Call text, image, speech, transcription, embedding, decision, and video models
Preserve existing hosting, authentication, billing, and provider routes
Manage app-funded per-user allowances, daily/monthly limits and AI usage reporting
interface.defaultPrompt: Add AI Pass to this application so end users can connect their own wallet and fund model usage. Preserve the current hosting, authentication, deployment, billing, and providers unless I explicitly ask to replace them.
